subject: Homepage · Latest research card shipped
summary: Added a permanent 'Research · Latest' section to the Stratum homepage, carrying Eglin's first research artifact. The section sits between the Briefing 017 hero and the reverse-chronological feed. Also corrected stale folio counts (Fifteen/15 → Seventeen/17) and promoted two new indigo design tokens to styles.css.
homepage_flow_position: hero (017) → RESEARCH · LATEST → feed (016–011) → ticker → rn-banner

changes: Added .research section CSS (77 lines) with --indigo-link scoped token
Added .research to fade-up animation list (delay .07s, between hero .04s and feed .1s)

Added <section class='research'> HTML between hero and feed — eyebrow 'Research · Latest', left-rail '88px No. 01 / T+88d narr.', title 'The People Graph, in 360°', dek, byline (Eglin · Industry research desk), CTA to research/people-graph-360.html, companion link to engineering/people-graph-substrate.html
Fixed archive link: 'See all 15 briefings' → 'See all 17 briefings'
Fixed masthead subhead: 'Sixteen issues, three products' → 'Seventeen issues, four products'
Promoted --indigo (#3d4d7d) and --indigo-link (#2e3b61) to system token level in :root accent block
Documented contrast ratios: --indigo 6.99:1 on --paper (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text pass, AAA large text); --indigo-link 9.33:1 on --paper (AAA body text pass)
Derivation rationale mirrors --ochre / --ochre-link pattern, documented in comment

design_decisions.placement: Between hero and feed as an independent section. The hero already uses a 1.65fr/1fr grid with the sidebar 'at a glance' card — inserting research alongside would require dismantling that sidebar. Single-column placement preserves hero integrity and separates content types cleanly.
design_decisions.visual_language: 2px indigo top border (vs 4px ink for hero, 1px ink for feed) — gives research a distinct weight class without overpowering. Left-rail mirroring the feed's 88px column keeps homepage rhythm coherent.
design_decisions.indigo_usage: --indigo (#3d4d7d) on borders/eyebrow chrome; --indigo-link (#2e3b61) on clickable text/CTA. Indigo at 6.99:1 is one unit shy of AAA for small text — new --indigo-link at 9.33:1 is fully AAA. This is the same derivation pattern as --ochre / --ochre-link.
design_decisions.future_extensibility: Eyebrow reads 'Research · Latest' (not 'Latest research') — semantic enough that a second card slots in without structural surgery. No dead 'Previous research' stub shipped; that chrome appears only when a second artifact exists.
design_decisions.companion_pointer: Inline in .research-companion at footer of the card — one line, not dramatised. The ticker already carries both entries at the top of the page.
design_decisions.byline_convention: Eglin (no 'By') + 'Industry research desk' — matches homepage convention of author name only.

checks_passing: All text roles: AAA contrast verified against --paper (#f4ecda)

o1_advance: Introduced --indigo-link token with documented AAA contrast derivation. Touch target compliant. Landmark semantics on new section. All text roles verified AAA before shipping — this is O-1 continuous practice, not post-hoc review.
